**Synopsis:**
The article flags a convergence of macro pressures — elevated bond yields at multi-decade highs, Brent crude above $100/bbl, and an escalating Middle East conflict — ahead of a cluster of central bank decisions. The ECB is expected to hike. The Fed's September 15-16 meeting is live, with ~60% odds of a hike priced in, contingent on incoming PPI (Thursday) and CPI (Friday) data. The BOJ is also on watch after a board member signaled broadening inflation near the 2% target, hinting at faster hikes. The yen has rallied 4% on the month. The overall tone is hawkish and risk-averse across the board.
